cochrane-compression-2021.title: Cochrane checkpoint: compression stockings — oedema
cochrane-compression-2021.citation: Compression stockings for preventing deep vein thrombosis in airline passengers. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews. DOI: 10.1002/14651858.CD004002.pub4
cochrane-compression-2021.curator_notes: One outcome checkpoint within a three-complete-review collection that is still in progress. Development reference, not adjudicated gold. Three reports contain six trial units; map each PDF once. Classification and screening are scored by report; trial-unit numeric extraction is not scored by the current report binding. Review-derived numerical inputs are retained separately for the deterministic replay. The review includes unpublished data. Kendall Table III resolves the abstract SD conflict, but Table IV has a conflicting 64 versus 66 denominator. GRADE Low is published; domain allocation is withheld. Keep review PDFs out of agent inputs.

pico.inclusion_text: Randomized long-flight trials reporting the composite oedema score. Preserve separately randomized short- and long-flight trial units within each report.

outcomes.name: Post-flight composite oedema score (lower scores better)
outcomes.method_note: Forest-plot settings transcribed and numerically replayed. Fixed inverse variance.
outcomes.source_locator: Analysis 1.3, printed page 39 (local PDF page 41); GRADE summary of findings, footnote 5.

cochrane-honey-2018.title: Cochrane checkpoint: honey — cough frequency
cochrane-honey-2018.citation: Honey for acute cough in children. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews. DOI: 10.1002/14651858.CD007094.pub5
cochrane-honey-2018.curator_notes: One outcome checkpoint within a three-complete-review collection that is still in progress. This is a development reference, not an adjudicated gold standard. One checkpoint; full-review collection in progress. Uses generic inverse variance with reported effect and SE; do not invent arm SDs. Review methods describe fixed effects but this forest is labelled random. Paul SE was supplied by author; Shadkam SE calculated by reviewers. GRADE Moderate is stated with footnotes mentioning both bias and imprecision; domain scores withheld pending adjudication. Both PDF renderings share pub5 and December 2018 amendment; pagination differs. Rounded trial estimates reproduce an upper CI of -0.62617 rather than the printed -0.62; retain the discrepancy.

pico.population: Children with acute cough in ambulatory settings

outcomes.name: Reduction in cough frequency score after one night, honey versus no treatment (7-point scale)
outcomes.method_note: Forest-plot settings transcribed and numerically replayed. Random effects shown; tau estimator needs explicit confirmation; tau²=0 for this checkpoint.
outcomes.source_locator: Analysis 1.3.1, printed page 49 (local 80-page PDF page 52). Official 79-page rendering uses printed page 48. Summary of findings 3, footnotes 2 and 3.

cochrane-vitamin-c-2013.title: Cochrane checkpoint: vitamin C — severe-stress cold incidence
cochrane-vitamin-c-2013.citation: Vitamin C for preventing and treating the common cold. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews. DOI: 10.1002/14651858.CD000980.pub4
cochrane-vitamin-c-2013.curator_notes: One outcome checkpoint within a three-complete-review collection that is still in progress. This is a development reference, not an adjudicated gold standard. One checkpoint; full-review collection in progress. No published GRADE label verified in this 2013 version. The author-hosted 2016 draft was rejected/unpublished and is excluded. Use the forest interval ending 0.64, not a rounded alternate abstract endpoint. Moolla is an unpublished thesis accepted in 1997; identity crosswalk retained. Inputs here are review-derived pending independent original-paper verification.

pico.population: People under short-term severe physical stress and/or cold exposure
pico.inclusion_text: Use the active severe-stress subgroup only; exclude sedentary control cohorts and combined-antioxidant arms.

outcomes.name: At least one cold during short-term severe physical stress and/or cold
outcomes.method_note: Forest-plot settings transcribed and numerically replayed. Fixed Mantel–Haenszel.
